name: COVID-19 Leave Support Scheme
description: A wage subsidy scheme providing financial support to businesses for employees unable to work due to COVID-19 self-isolation requirements or related health circumstances.

attributes.summary: A wage subsidy scheme providing financial support to businesses for employees unable to work due to COVID-19 self-isolation requirements or related health circumstances.
attributes.eligibility: Businesses with employees unable to work due to COVID-19 self-isolation requirements or related health circumstances. Eligible groups include employees required to self-isolate, employees with dependants needing support, employees at higher risk from COVID-19, self-employed persons, employees on fixed-term, casual, and seasonal contracts, and newly hired employees. Exclusions: state sector organisations generally not eligible, businesses not registered and operating in New Zealand, and employees not legally working in New Zealand.
attributes.payment_details: Amount business must pay employee based on ordinary wages or salary relative to subsidy rate.
attributes.obligations: Retain employees named in application, follow employment law when paying wages or salary, and repay unused funds after payment period.
attributes.application_process: Applications are submitted by businesses on behalf of eligible employees.
